security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU's exception delivery path writes the faulting effective address into *tval (stval/mtval/htval) either unconditionally applying pointer masking when PM is disabled for the active privilege mode, or failing to apply pointer masking when PM is enabled and applicable to that explicit memory access.
security_spec.summary: Exception handler writes to *tval must conditionally apply pointer masking based on whether PM is enabled for the faulting privilege mode; unconditional or absent masking leaks raw vs. transformed addresses to the trap handler, undermining guest security assumptions.
